These four fixtures are reduced public BGS gameplay exports retrieved on 2026-11-01.
Usernames, user IDs, timing and presence data were removed; game slugs, moves,
scoring logs, setup and result fields used by the parser remain unchanged.

- https://www.boardgamers.space/api/gameplay/Modern-riddle-1723 — base game
- https://www.boardgamers.space/api/gameplay/Jubilant-rover-3041 — Lost Fleet
- https://www.boardgamers.space/api/gameplay/Comfy-snail-3333 — Lost Fleet, auction
- https://www.boardgamers.space/api/gameplay/Proper-outpost-7588 — Lost Fleet, two players

These are regression examples, not a representative strategy dataset.
